questions.question: What makes the trio of website helpers shallow?
options: Each function is fewer than ten lines.
Together they make callers learn three names, an order, and a URL hand-off for little work.
questions.explanation: Shallowness is about the ratio of interface to functionality. Short functions are not the problem; the amount callers must learn is.

questions.question: Where should the rule "the first sentence states the main activity" live?
options: In every caller that needs the activity
In a comment at the top of the project
In the module that owns the About page, as main_activity
questions.explanation: Pulling the rule down into the page module means callers cannot forget or disagree about it.

questions.question: Which change would make CompanyWebsites shallower?
options: Making callers pass the page dictionary to every about_page call
Returning an AboutPage instead of a dictionary
questions.explanation: Pushing the data back out to every call grows the interface without adding functionality. Caching inside the module would make it deeper, not shallower.
